title: Tips for Expats Moving to Dubai in 2024
author: Prestige Luxury Real Estate
html:
Dubai continues to be a top destination for expatriates seeking new opportunities and experiences. If you're considering a move to Dubai in 2024, here are some valuable tips to help you kickstart your exciting journey:

1. Plan Ahead

  • Begin your preparations well in advance to ensure a smooth transition.
  • Research Dubai's cost of living, job market, and cultural nuances to set realistic expectations.

2. Visa and Documentation

  • Understand the visa requirements for your specific situation.
  • Ensure your passport is valid for at least six months from your planned arrival date.

3. Accommodation

  • Explore different neighbourhoods and choose one that aligns with your lifestyle and budget.
  • Be ready to pay a security deposit and rent upfront, a common practice in Dubai.

4. Employment

  • Start your job search early and secure a job offer if possible.
  • Verify that your potential employer offers a clear contract and sponsorship for your work visa.

5. Healthcare

  • Familiarise yourself with Dubai's healthcare system and obtain health insurance.
  • Carry essential medical records and prescriptions, especially if you have specific healthcare needs.

6. Budget Wisely

  • Create a comprehensive budget that covers expenses like rent, groceries, transportation, and more.
  • Remember that Dubai generally has no income tax, but there are other costs to consider.

7. Cultural Sensitivity

  • Learn about Dubai's culture and traditions, and respect local customs.
  • Dress modestly in public areas and avoid public displays of affection.

8. Transportation

  • Consider using public transportation or rideshare services for daily commuting.
  • If you plan to drive in Dubai, obtain a valid driver's licence and familiarise yourself with local traffic rules.

9. Language

  • While English is widely spoken, learning basic Arabic phrases can enhance your experience.

10. Social Networking

  • Join expat communities and online forums to connect with like-minded individuals.
  • Attend local events and gatherings to build your social network.

11. Banking

  • Open a local bank account to simplify financial transactions.
  • Stay informed about currency exchange rates and international transaction fees.

12. Legal Matters

  • Understand Dubai's laws and regulations to avoid legal complications.
  • Know your rights and responsibilities as an expatriate resident.

13. Safety

  • Dubai is generally considered a safe city, but exercise caution as you would anywhere else.
  • Keep your personal belongings secure and be cautious of potential scams or fraud.

14. Adaptability

  • Approach your new life in Dubai with an open mind and flexibility.
  • Embrace the unique opportunities and experiences that the city has to offer.

15. Enjoy Your Stay

  • Explore Dubai's iconic landmarks, diverse cuisine, and vibrant entertainment options.
  • Make the most of your time in Dubai by immersing yourself in the local culture and embracing the expat community.

Moving to Dubai is an exciting adventure that offers a blend of modernity and tradition. By following these tips and staying informed, you'll be better prepared to embark on your expat journey in 2024. Wishing you a successful and fulfilling experience in Dubai!

title: 9 Crucial Mistakes to Avoid When Buying Off-Plan Properties
author: Prestige Luxury Real Estate
html:
Investing in off-plan properties can be an exciting and profitable venture, but it comes with its own set of challenges. Therefore, it's crucial to be aware of common pitfalls. Here's a comprehensive guide to avoiding these mistakes and making the most out of your off-plan property investment.

1. Doing Impulsive Off-Plan Purchases

The appeal of a new development can sometimes lead to impulsive buying decisions. It's essential to take a step back and conduct thorough research. Evaluate the credibility of the developer, the location, the potential for appreciation, and how the property fits into your investment portfolio. Remember, patience is not just a virtue but a strategic move in real estate investment.

2. Setting Unclear Investment Goals

Before embarking on your property journey, clarify your investment objectives. Are you looking for a quick resale profit, or do you aim to generate rental income? Your goals will determine the type of property you should invest in, its location, and the price point. Clear goals act as a compass that guides your investment decisions.

3. Misunderstanding the Off-Plan Timeline

Many investors underestimate the time it takes for a property to transition from a blueprint to a building. Be realistic about construction timelines and factor in the possibility of delays. Delays are not simply inconveniences—they could impact your financial planning, especially if you're relying on rental income.

4. Overlooking All Purchase Costs

The price tag on the brochure is just the beginning. Additional costs such as agency fees, Dubai Land Department fees, and maintenance costs can add up. Budgeting for these expenses from the outset will ensure that you're not caught off guard and can maintain your financial stability.

5. Neglecting Project Progress

Stay engaged with the development process of your off-plan property. Regular updates from the developer are essential, and site visits can be invaluable. Tracking progress helps you address any concerns early and reassures you that your investment is materialising as expected.

6. Failing to Keep Up with Payment Schedules

Off-plan property agreements often come with staggered payment plans that coincide with construction milestones. Missing a payment can result in hefty penalties and even contract termination. Keep a calendar of due dates and set reminders to keep your payments on track.

7. Forgetting Thorough Developer Research

The developer is as important as the property itself. Research their past projects, financial health, and reputation in the market. A trustworthy developer not only delivers a quality product but also upholds transparency throughout the construction phase.

8. Ignoring Legal Due Diligence

The excitement of a new property should not overshadow the need for legal scrutiny. Review all contract terms, understand your rights, and be aware of the specifics of the escrow account. Consulting with a real estate lawyer can provide clarity and safeguard your investment.

9. Being Neglectful of Market Trends

The real estate market is dynamic, and market trends can greatly affect property values. Stay informed about economic indicators, real estate cycles, and market sentiment. This knowledge will help you time your purchase and sale, maximising your return on investment.

In conclusion, buying off-plan properties in Dubai or elsewhere requires a strategic approach and attention to detail. By avoiding these common mistakes, you can ensure that your off-plan property investment is sound, secure, and successful. View our available off-plan properties from trusted developers today!

title: The Role of AI in Streamlining Real Estate Transactions
author: Prestige Luxury Real Estate
html:
The real estate industry is one of the oldest and most substantial sectors in the economy, and it’s witnessing a transformative wave thanks to Artificial Intelligence (AI). Embracing AI in real estate is like inviting a futuristic friend into an old, traditional house. This friend helps you sort out the clutter, streamline processes, and add a touch of modern efficiency to everything. Let's learn how AI is revolutionising real estate transactions.

Understanding The Basics

At its core, AI involves machines and software that are capable of intelligent behaviour. In real estate, this means using AI to analyse data, automate mundane tasks, and provide predictive insights. The goal? To make real estate transactions faster, simpler, and more efficient.

1. The Magic of Automated Valuations

Property valuation is crucial in real estate, but it can be time-consuming and subjective. AI comes to the rescue with automated valuation models (AVMs). These models use machine learning to analyse various factors like property size, location, and market trends. Consequently, this provides a more accurate and instant property appraisal. For buyers and sellers, this means getting reliable information without a long wait.

2. Smart Matchmaking

Searching for the perfect property or the ideal buyer can be like finding a needle in a haystack. AI transforms this tedious process into a smart matchmaking journey. By analysing user behaviour, preferences, and interactions, AI algorithms can recommend properties that align closely with a buyer’s needs or suggest potential buyers to sellers.

3. Efficient Paperwork Handling

Real estate transactions are infamous for their paperwork. AI is here to declutter your desk and your mind. With the ability to read, understand, and process documents at lightning speed, AI reduces the risk of human error and speeds up the transaction process.

4. Virtual Property Tours

Imagine being able to tour a property without stepping out of your house. Virtual reality (VR) and AI create immersive property tours, allowing buyers to explore every nook and cranny of a property from the comfort of their couch. It's not just convenient, it’s a game-changer, especially for international buyers or those with hectic schedules.

5. Predictive Analytics

The real estate market is influenced by numerous variables and is thus unpredictable. AI steps in with predictive analytics. By analysing market trends, economic indicators, and other relevant data, AI provides insights into property values, investment potential, and market conditions. For investors and homeowners, this means making informed decisions backed by data, not just gut feelings.

6. Enhanced Customer Service

Questions and queries are part of any real estate transaction. AI-powered chatbots and virtual assistants work round-the-clock, providing instant responses and solutions to clients. They’re friendly, knowledgeable, and don’t need coffee breaks, ensuring that clients feel heard and always valued.

7. Security and Fraud Detection

The real estate sector is not immune to fraud, and AI is on the front lines, defending against deceptive practices. Using pattern recognition and anomaly detection, AI systems can identify suspicious activities, safeguarding the interests of buyers and sellers alike.

The Human Touch

While AI brings efficiency and accuracy to the table, the human touch remains irreplaceable in real estate. Building relationships, understanding emotions, and providing personalized advice are areas where humans excel. AI and human expertise together create a powerhouse team that ensures clients receive the best of both worlds.

Looking Ahead

The integration of AI in real estate is not just a trend, but a paradigm shift. As technology continues to evolve, we can expect even more innovative solutions that simplify real estate transactions and enhance customer experiences. The future of real estate is here, and it’s intelligent, efficient, and incredibly exciting.

So, whether you're a buyer, seller, or real estate professional, embrace the change, welcome the AI friend, and get ready for smoother, faster, and more enjoyable real estate transactions. Welcome to the future of real estate, where technology and humanity join forces to create unparalleled experiences.

title: Blockchain and Dubai's Real Estate Revolution
author: Prestige Luxury Real Estate
html:
Dubai is once again at the forefront of technological advancements. This time, it's the real estate sector that's undergoing a transformation—thanks to blockchain technology. But what is blockchain, and how is it reshaping property transactions in Dubai?

Understanding Blockchain

In simple terms, blockchain is a digital ledger that records transactions in a secure, transparent, and tamper-proof manner. Each transaction is stored in a 'block' and linked to the previous one, forming a 'chain'. This decentralized system ensures that data is not stored in a single location, making it resistant to hacks and unauthorized alterations.

Blockchain in Dubai's Real Estate

Dubai's vision to become the first city fully powered by blockchain by 2020 has paved the way for its integration into various sectors, including real estate. Here's how blockchain is revolutionizing property transactions in the city:

Transparency and Trust

One of the main advantages of blockchain is its transparency. Every transaction is recorded and can be viewed by all parties involved. This transparency builds trust, especially crucial in real estate where significant sums of money are involved.

Efficiency and Speed

Traditional property transactions involve multiple steps, from due diligence to contract signing and registration. Blockchain simplifies this process. Smart contracts, powered by blockchain, can automatically execute, and verify agreements when conditions are met, reducing the need for intermediaries, and speeding up transactions.

Reduced Costs

With blockchain, many administrative and intermediary costs associated with property transactions can be eliminated. This reduction can lead to more affordable property deals and investments.

Enhanced Security

The decentralized nature of blockchain and its cryptographic protection makes it highly secure. This security is vital in real estate transactions, ensuring that property records are safe from tampering and fraud.

Global Investments

Blockchain can facilitate cross-border property transactions. As a result, it’s easier for international investors to invest in Dubai's real estate. With transparent and swift transactions, global investors can confidently enter the property market.

Current and Possible Real-world Applications in Dubai

Several initiatives in Dubai highlight the practical application of blockchain in real estate:

Dubai Land Department (DLD)

DLD has launched a blockchain system that records all real estate contracts, including lease registrations. This system connects property owners and tenants directly to various service providers, such as electricity, water, and telecommunications.

Real Estate Self Transaction (REST)

An initiative by DLD, REST aims to conduct real estate transactions entirely through blockchain and smart contracts. This platform will allow landlords and tenants to finalize contracts without service centres, reducing transaction times from days to mere minutes.

Tokenization of Properties

This concept involves converting the value of a property into digital tokens that can be traded. It can allow investors to buy 'shares' in a property, democratizing real estate investment.

Improved Property Search Platforms

Blockchain can power property listing platforms, ensuring that listings are accurate, transparent, and up to date.

Seamless Rental Experiences

From paying rent to reporting maintenance issues, blockchain can streamline the rental experience for both landlords and tenants.

Conclusion

Blockchain technology, with its promise of transparency, efficiency, and security, is set to redefine Dubai's real estate landscape. As the city continues to embrace this technology, property transactions will become smoother, faster, and more trustworthy. For investors, property owners, and tenants, the future of real estate in Dubai looks not just promising but also incredibly exciting.

title: Embracing Digital Marketing Strategies for Luxury Real Estate

html:
In the age of technology and the Internet, the way we sell and buy luxury homes has changed dramatically. Digital marketing, in simple words, is using the Internet to promote and sell products or services. And for the luxury real estate market, this means a big change. This post will break down how to embrace digital marketing strategies to stay ahead of the curve in the luxury real estate market.

Understanding Your Audience

The first step in digital marketing is knowing who you're selling to. Are they successful business owners, retired individuals, or young entrepreneurs? Maybe they're foreigners looking for a luxury getaway? Once you understand your audience, you can tailor your digital content to attract and engage them. This could mean using certain language, images, or focusing on particular aspects of the properties.

Creating a Strong Online Presence

Creating a strong online presence is key in digital marketing. This can include having a professional and easy-to-navigate website, active social media profiles, and possibly even a blog. Posting high-quality photos and videos of your properties can really catch people's eyes and show off the luxury you're offering.

SEO Optimization

SEO stands for "Search Engine Optimization". This might sound complicated, but it really means making sure your online content (like your website or blog) is easy for search engines (like Google) to find. This is done by using certain keywords in your content that potential buyers might use when they're searching online. For example, if you're selling luxury beachfront homes, you might want to include words like "luxury", "beachfront", and "home" in your content.

Social Media Marketing

Social media platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn are perfect for marketing luxury real estate. By using these platforms, you can connect with a large number of potential buyers. Sharing high-quality images and videos of your properties, along with engaging content about the local community or amenities, can attract buyers.

Email Marketing

Email marketing is another useful digital strategy. It involves sending emails to a list of people who have shown interest in your properties. These emails can include information about new listings, open houses, and other important updates. Make sure to keep the emails professional and engaging - and don't forget to add lots of nice photos!

Virtual Tours

One of the benefits of digital marketing in real estate is the ability to provide virtual tours of properties. This allows potential buyers to get a feel for the property without leaving their home. Using technologies like 3D imaging and drone photography, you can create immersive virtual experiences that showcase the full value of your luxury properties.

Paid Advertising

Another digital marketing strategy is paid advertising. This could be ads on social media, search engines, or other websites. The great thing about digital advertising is that you can target it to certain groups of people - for example, people who have visited your website before, or people who live in a certain area.

Conclusion

As the world becomes more and more digital, the luxury real estate market must adapt. By embracing digital marketing strategies, luxury real estate agents can reach more potential buyers and showcase their properties in new, exciting ways. So get online, start creating and sharing, and see the amazing effects digital marketing can have on your business.

title: Flying High: The Advantages of Using Drones for Property Inspections
author: Prestige Luxury Real Estate
html:
The rapid evolution of technology has brought about innovative solutions in various sectors, and real estate is no exception. One technology that is transforming the way property inspections are conducted is the use of drones. With their unique aerial perspectives and advanced imaging capabilities, drones are revolutionizing the property inspection process. Here are some advantages of utilizing drones for property inspections:

1.      Enhanced Safety

Conducting property inspections, particularly for large properties or buildings with multiple stories, can pose several safety risks. Drones eliminate the need for inspectors to climb ladders, walk on roofs, or access other potentially dangerous areas. They can easily navigate and capture high-resolution images or videos of hard-to-reach areas, reducing the risk of accidents.

2.      Time and Cost Efficiency

Traditional property inspections can be time-consuming and costly, especially for larger properties. Drones, on the other hand, can cover large areas in a short amount of time, significantly reducing the time and resources needed for an inspection. This efficiency translates into cost savings for both property inspectors and property owners.

3.      Comprehensive Reporting

Drones equipped with advanced imaging technology can capture detailed, high-resolution images and videos of a property. These images can be used to create comprehensive reports that provide an accurate representation of the property's condition. Such thorough documentation can help property owners identify potential issues that may not be visible from the ground.

4.      Accessibility

Certain areas of a property may be difficult or impossible to inspect using traditional methods. Drones can easily access and inspect these areas, such as steep roofs, tall chimneys, or areas obscured by vegetation. This makes drones an invaluable tool for inspecting a wide range of properties.

5.      Preventative Maintenance

Through thermal imaging capabilities, drones can help detect issues that may not be apparent to the naked eye, such as water leaks or insulation gaps. By identifying these problems early, property owners can undertake preventative maintenance measures, potentially saving significant repair costs down the line.

6.      Real-time Visuals

Drones offer the advantage of real-time visualization, which allows property inspectors to assess the condition of the property immediately. This can be particularly beneficial during the sale or purchase of a property, where time can be of the essence.

7.      Enhanced Marketability

For real estate agents, high-quality aerial images or videos captured by drones can significantly enhance the marketability of a property. A bird's eye view can highlight the property's layout, the surrounding landscape, and other attractive features, offering potential buyers a unique perspective.

Conclusion

Drones are an incredibly useful tool for property inspections, offering benefits in safety, efficiency, and accuracy. As technology continues to advance, we can expect the role of drones in the real estate sector to expand even further, marking a new era in property inspection processes. It's time to embrace the power of drone technology and soar to new heights in property inspections.

title: Your Guide to Buying Off Plan Properties in Dubai
author: Prestige Luxury Real Estate
html:
As one of the world's fastest-growing cities, Dubai boasts a thriving real estate market that attracts individuals and companies worldwide. If you're considering investing in off plan property in Dubai, it's crucial to grasp the concept and understand the purchasing process. Let us guide you through the ins and outs of off plan investments in Dubai.

What is an Off Plan Property?

Off plan properties refer to real estate properties that are available for purchase before they are constructed. They exist only as architectural plans and models at the time of purchase, and the buyer decides to invest based on these blueprints, along with other promotional materials provided by the property developer. The actual physical property is yet to be built, hence the term 'off plan'. This concept has gained significant traction in Dubai's real estate sector.

Why Invest in Off Plan Properties?

Investing in off plan properties comes with several benefits. Firstly, they are often priced lower than completed properties, allowing investors to secure high-value assets at a fraction of the cost. This makes off plan properties a great entry point for individuals looking to start their real estate investment journey.

Secondly, they provide the potential for substantial capital appreciation. The value of off plan properties often increases from the time of purchase to the time of completion. Consequently, investors can make profits if they choose to sell post-completion.

Additionally, developers usually offer flexible payment plans for buyers to manage their finances. This, combined with the fact that off plan properties are brand new and can be customised to the buyer's preference, makes them an attractive investment option.

How to Purchase Off Plan Properties in Dubai

Step 1: Property Selection

The first step in purchasing an off plan property involves selecting the right property that aligns with your budget and requirements. An experienced real estate agent can provide invaluable assistance at this stage. They can help you navigate the market and identify the best opportunities for maximum return on investment.

Step 2: Property Viewing

The next one involves visiting the developer's sales office to understand the project's features and benefits. Here, you can explore the project through demonstration tools such as miniature models, brochures, or virtual tours. Some developers may also have a show property available for viewing.

Step 3: Property Booking

Once you've chosen the unit type, you'll need to pay a booking fee, typically 5-10% of the property price, to secure the unit. This step also involves signing a booking form for the selected unit.

Step 4: First Instalment and DLD Fees

After booking, you'll be asked to complete your first instalment or down payment and pay the government registration fees. These fees are typically 4%, though some developers may offer waivers or discounts.

Step 5: Signing the SPA

Next, you'll need to sign the Sales and Purchase Agreement (SPA), a legal document that outlines the terms and conditions of the sale. The developer will send you this document to sign and return.

Step 6: Oqood Registration

Oqood registration, a crucial step in the process, guarantees your purchase is officially registered with the Dubai Land Department. After completion, you will receive your initial contract of sale.

Step 7: Settling Due Instalments

As per the agreed payment plan, you'll be asked to pay a certain percentage of the purchase value before you're eligible to receive your property.

Step 8: Project Completion

In accordance with the SPA, the developer is obligated to complete the construction and deliver the property by the agreed-upon date.

Step 9: Inspection and Handover

Once the required payment for handover has been settled, you'll be invited to inspect your property. It's recommended to appoint a professional snagging team at this stage to ensure the quality of your unit for future use.

Final Thoughts

To sum up, investing in off plan properties in Dubai offers a unique opportunity to participate in one of the most dynamic real estate markets globally. By balancing the potential rewards with the inherent risks, and with the help of trusted professionals, you can make informed decisions that align with your investment goals. Ultimately, buying off-plan can provide both financial benefits and the unique satisfaction of owning a piece of Dubai's ever-evolving skyline.

title: Off plan property: a great investment?
author: Prestige Luxury Real Estate
html:
Temperatures in Dubai might be cool at the moment, but the off plan property market remains red hot!

According to The National, off plan sales hit a 12 year high in Q3 2022 in both value and volume, with 25,456 sales recorded. Global economic headwinds might feel like nothing more than a light breeze in Dubai, but real assets, especially off plan property are proving to be the shelter of choice for many investors looking to protect and grow their capital in the UAE.

What is off plan property?

Off plan property is the term used for buying real estate before it’s built. Buying off plan is generally cheaper than buying already constructed real estate with between a 10-30% reduction from existing constructed real estate.

Why is off plan property cheaper?

Off plan property is cheaper than pre-constructed property as you’re buying into a plan. There might be like for like comparisons price wise in the area based on the plan vs existing builds, however this value is not guaranteed until construction is complete. The price of off plan property increase as a project gets closer to completion as the investment risk reduces and those who are looking to move homes quickly enter the market.

What happens if a developer doesn’t deliver?

As with any investment, your money is never 100% safe. Even with pre-constructed real estate, your property could decrease in value from your purchase price and you could lose some of the invested capital.

However, since the 2008 global market crash the Dubai Government has introduced a number of measures to protect investors from losing their money, including the Escrow Law. The Escrow Law means that all of the client monies collected by the developer, towards the purchase of an off plan property, must be held in a segregated Escrow Account and will only be released to the developer upon the project reaching certain construction milestones. This makes it in the developer’s interest to build on time and to finish the project.

How do I purchase off plan property?

To purchase off plan property, you can either go direct to the developer or through a licenced real estate agent, such as those at Prestige Luxury Real Estate. Agents are a great option for those who want help finding the right property and are open to numerous different developers. Agents have access and oversite across the whole market and remunerated by the developer not the client.

Once you have found the right off plan development for you, there are several ways to make to make payment, the most popular being cash or payment plans.

Payment plans allow buyers to spread the cost over a period of time. These typically take the form of 50/50 (50% paid during construction and 50% on completion) 60/40 or 40/60. Some are even offering plans where after you have paid your deposit, typically 10- 20%, you can pay between 1% and 4% monthly over 5 years. There are many versions of the payment plan, it all depends on the developer or development.

Is it easy to sell off plan property before completion?

There is a booming secondary off plan market in Dubai. Some people buy off plan property with the intension of simply selling as the property nears completion and the price rises. This is something your real estate agent can help with.

What should I consider if I'm buying to rent?

Buying to rent could offers investors return on their initial investment price as the completed property rises in value and meets market rates, but also a yearly yield on their investment on top of this.

The rental market is hot in Dubai right now and your real estate broker should be able to find you a tenant with ease. However, some developers also directly team up with hotel chains and will offer a guaranteed ROI of around 7-8% on a short-term bases, letting the unit out on your behalf.

In summary, off plan property is a fantastic option for those looking to buy a future home, buy to let or simply as an addition to their investment portfolio.

title: New Career? Everything you need to know about working in Real Estate in Dubai.
author: Prestige Luxury Real Estate
html:
You've heard about the tax free, uncapped commission and huge earning potential. You've seen the world class apartments and villas for rent & sale in Dubai. You've watched the glamorous Netflix shows and now you're ready to pursue a career in a Real Estate. 2020 was the year people saw their homes as so much more than "just a place to live." We turned our humble abodes into offices, gyms, schools and bars! So it is no wonder the Real Estate industry in Dubai is booming!

As a recruitment consultant I am fortunate enough to speak to people daily who are considering a career within the UAE's Real Estate industry. My aim is to not only sell the job and initial relocation to potential candidates but to give them the opportunity to build a long and successful career. This means being totally honest and transparent through the whole on boarding process.

So, here is my guide to a few key factors to take into consideration before signing that offer:

1) Commission only: The Real Estate industry in Dubai does not offer the "safety net" of a basic salary as the generous commission structures far outweigh capped earning potential. The Real Estate industry attracts target driven, money hungry, ambitious individuals who are drawn to the idea of essentially running their own mini business. This means that the harder you work, the more you can earn.

2) Start up costs: So due to the above you will need to ensure you are financially comfortable to get started. You will need to factor in all costs involved with the initial relocation & living expenses for your first few months. We recommend having enough savings to cover these costs and live comfortably for a minimum of 3 months. This includes accommodation, bills, car hire and day to day living costs. Also, it is recommended that you speak to the recruiter about any additional fees that may be taken out of your commissions each month. For example, some agencies may charge additional fees for things such as marketing, admin & medical insurance.*

3) Do your market research: How is the property market performing? How does the UAE market compare to your local market? What tools will the agency provide to support you in the early days of your journey? Which areas are most transactional? Does your chosen agency offer a training program? If so, what does the training entail? Any good recruiter will be happy to give you a detailed breakdown of this ahead of the move to prepare you.

4) The workload: Real Estate is not your average 9-5 so if you're a clock in, clock out type of person this is not for you. Real Estate requires hard work, dedication and long working hours. This includes evenings and weekends. You need to be prepared to spend your first few months building your pipeline and hammering the phones. You are the master of your own success and have full control of each aspect of the role. That includes speaking with landlords and tenants and listing your properties as well as the viewings. Most of your time will be spent in the office, on the phone. Don't be fooled by the glamorous Netflix documentaries,

5) You get out what you put in: Think you can sit back and wait for the deals to come to you? Think again. Real Estate is a competitive industry and you will need to be fully committed to being the best and most successful version of yourself that you can be.

To sum up all of the above Real Estate is a fantastic opportunity for anybody who is looking to enhance their earning potential within an exciting industry. However, nothing is handed to you on a plate. You need to be prepared. Have enough savings, have confidence in the company you are joining, keep in contact with your recruiter in the lead up to the move, ask questions and enjoy the process!

title: 6 Interesting facts to know about Dubai shopping festival
author: Prestige Luxury Real Estate
html:
Top 6 things to look forward to during Dubai Shopping Festival

A  fireworks spectacle,  a star-studded event, a hologram concert and a 12-hour flash sale are set to   kick off the highly anticipated Dubai Shopping Festival (DSF) as it returns for its 25th run. The Dubai Festivals and Retail Establishment (DFRE) recently revealed the full line-up of things to look forward to in the landmark edition of the shopping extravaganza that will run for 38 days from December 26, 2019, to February 1, 2020. An opening ceremony at Burj Park, Downtown Dubai will feature a series of concerts by Emirati and international singers, cultural and family-oriented performances from 2pm to 11pm on December 26 and 27.

The city will also be lit up with fireworks, adding colour and sparkle to Dubai's skyline. And if you're ready to shop, you can head straight to Majid Al Futtaim (MAF) malls where an exclusive 12-hour sale will give customers up to 90 per cent off. Running from mid-day to midnight on December 26, the sale will also see 25 winners take home Dh10,000 worth of shopping vouchers for Mall of the Emirates, City Centre Mirdif, City Centre Deira, City Centre Me'aisem, My City Centre Barsha and City Centre Al Shindagha.

"As Dubai has evolved in the last 25 years, so too has DSF.  As we unveil our milestone DSF 2020, it highlights and affirms the festival's greatest edition yet," said Ahmed Al Khaja, CEO of DFRE. "Every DSF, we see Dubai at its best. The weather is wonderful, and our key partners and retailers across Dubai make an incredible effort to ensure that people from every culture, age and background come together in celebration of their love of shopping, entertainment and the opportunity to win great prizes."

With more than 1,000 brands participating across  4,000 outlets, shoppers and deal-hunters will find offers of up to 75 per cent off across the city - on top of showstopping performances, immersive experiences, and family-friendly celebrations. Here are top six things to look forward to throughout the fest.

Concerts - including Dubai's first hologram concert

Global superstars from around the world will be flying in for the festival: Pakistani sensation Rahat Ali Khan will be at Coca-Cola Arena on December 27, while British pop star Ellie Goulding will be on the stage on January 10. You can also catch Egyptian superstar Amr Diab at Dubai Media City Amphitheatre on January 24.

On top of headliners, the first ever hologram concert in the city will debut this DSF, featuring a hologram of Umm Kulthum accompanied by a live orchestra of 20 musicians on stage. Watch the show at the Dubai Opera Grand Theatre on December 26 and 27.

Fireworks every day

A beloved DSF tradition: There will be something in the air throughout the festival as world-class fireworks displays paint the skies with colour and light every night at The Beach, Al Seef, La Mer, Dubai Festival City, Dubai Creek, The Pointe and The Dubai Frame.

A special DSF mobile game!

A unique feature this year, Yalla DSF is an interactive and innovative mobile game that will engage visitors and residents. It's available in English, Arabic, Mandarin and Russian. The game will give players a chance to win exclusive prizes that are instantly redeemable. Saved to phone home screens rather than a downloadable app, it will direct players to move around Dubai to activate levels and win bigger prizes, including an entry to a grand raffle.

City lights for the 'gram

Music, mirrors and colourful lights will combine to deliver the most 'Instagrammable' moments in a unique festival vibe. Don't miss the interactive light installations at Burj Plaza from January 7 to February 1, 2020.

And for the bargain-hunters ...

Besides discounts of 25 to 75 per cent on thousands of international fashion, beauty, home and lifestyle brands - there will be special sales and retail surprises, too. In a welcome tradition, DSF will kick off in style with an exclusive '12-Hour Sale' at Majid Al Futtaim (MAF) Malls, giving customers up to 90 per cent off at Mall of the Emirates, City Centre Mirdif, City Centre Deira, City Centre Me'aisem, My City Centre Barsha, and City Centre Al Shindagha.

Then, from January 2 to 26 2020, shopaholics are encouraged to keep DSF on their radar to discover daily surprise deals over 25 days. Deals are announced 24 hours in advance for one brand at one location. And for the first time at DSF, a series of pop-up markets will appear across the city at Last Exit, Al Khawaneej, Al Rigga Street and City Walk 2, combining the heritage of Dubai with innovative retail experiences. Inspired by the bustling souks of the UAE, a traditional style market stretching 1.8km along the Dubai Creek in Al Seef will allow visitors to experience different cultures, enjoy shopping, dining, art and entertainment from around the world. Running from January 16 to February 1, 2020, Market Outside the Box will showcase the hottest up-and-coming local, regional and international musicians and bands, as well as fashion and food vendors.

Prizes and freebies

Shop and win promotions will be run at several malls and shops across the emirate - including MAF and The Dubai Mall - on top of the highly popular Infiniti and Nissan raffle draws. As for the freebies, anyone who purchases an Emirates economy class ticket to Dubai from now until February 1, 2020, - with a return journey between December 26, 2019, and February 5, 2020 - will enjoy an extra 10kg baggage allowance for all their DSF purchases on the return trip home. This offer is limited to certain countries.

Source: Gulf News

title: What Is EXPO 2020 Really Bringing to Dubai-UAE?
author: Prestige Luxury Real Estate
html:
The World’s Greatest Show is coming to Dubai on the 20th of October, 2020 and will take place until the 10th of April, 2021, with 192 countries participating.

With around 25 million visitors expected to visit Dubai to attend the Expo, it is already positively impacting the Emirates economy. Furthermore, the international community looks to the UAE and the participating countries to provide sustainable solutions to the world’s most heated issues.

A series of celebrations across the United Arab Emirates marking the one-year countdown to the Expo 2020 will take place on Sunday, the 20th of October, and for this reason, we decided to remind you how big Dubai’s upcoming Expo will be and what it will offer.

Expo 2020 Dubai brings back sustainable architecture in the UAE.

The United Arab Emirates along with other GCC states have the highest energy consumption per capita in the world. The Emirati government has narrowed down the reason for this high energy demand to the wide use of air conditioners during the heated months of summer.

However, before these countries moved to modern architecture, and even before the invention of AC’s, the nomads of the Arabian desert used to build their homes in a way that keeps the temperature low.

As Dubai prepares for Expo 2020, the UAE’s national pavilion announcements show a revival of low-tech sustainability is underway.

Learn More about EXPO Villas / Properties>> View details


 

Siemens announces it will use Dubai’s expo as a testing ground for smart cities

For the Expo 2020, Siemens, the largest industrial manufacturing company in Europe, has installed a number of high-tech, state-of-the-art smart building technologies, boosting efficiency, comfort, and safety. The company will manage 132 buildings digitally connected together across a space of 4.38 square kilometers. The data collected by Siemens during the Expo 2020 will be used in future smart cities projects, such as District 2020 in Dubai.

The countdown begins as Dubai vouches to reveal the first ropeless elevator

The world’s first-ever ropeless elevator, with the ability to move multiple carts at once, is coming to Dubai in the light of the Expo 2020. The pioneering invention will offer double the capacity of passengers of regular elevators. In addition, this new and improved elevator can use 70 percent less power than its traditional counterpart, as it depends on magnetism instead of gravity. The project was first revealed in 2017 and will expand beyond elevators as the managing company sets its sight at underground transportation systems.

Dubai’s metro is getting an upgrade to serve millions of visitors at Expo 2020 Dubai

The Dubai Red Metro Line has expanded in a five-stage project across a 435-hectare area dedicated to the Expo 2020 events. This expansion is the first step towards Route 2020, a project that aims to showcase Dubai’s expansion and its promising future. Once delivered, the Route 2020 project will be the first prominent rail expansion of the highly successful Dubai Metro Red Line and Green Line projects.

56 percent of contracts are assigned to small and medium-sized enterprises

With almost a year to go until Dubai’s Expo 2020, around the region, small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) are growing. Organizers of the event realize this, and in support, they decided to dedicate 56 percent of contracts at the Expo to SMEs.

Other regulations were put in place to encourage small and medium-sized business owners, with the Emirates NB, the Expo 2020’s official banking partner, announcing that SMEs are to be provided with preferential loan rates, working capital support, and low minimum balance requirements.

Statistics predict that next year’s Expo will contribute almost USD 33 billion to Dubai’s economy

This is the first time the worldwide-celebrated event comes to the Middle East, and so Dubai decided to either go big or go home, and going big is exactly what they did. From mind-blowing architecture to on the ground sustainable solutions, the Expo 2020 is set to exceed Shangahi’s 2010 Expo, one of the best to ever be organized.

The Expo 2020 sets to bolster Dubai’s reputation as the region’s main business hub. It is estimated that around USD 33 billion will be provided through investments to boost the Emirate’s local economy.

New jobs are created for thousands at the Expo 2020 Dubai

The Expo 2020 is set to create around 275,000 job opportunities in the next six years all around the region. These will be in the sectors of aviation, construction, retail, and transportation.

Around USD 353 million road projects opened ahead of the Expo 2020 Dubai

In preparation for the high number of tourists coming to the UAE, a number of megaprojects in transportation infrastructure is scheduled to open doors to the public ahead of the Expo 2020. The USD 353 million worth of road projects includes a series of flyovers, ramps, and widened roads that are currently under construction.

According to Gulf News, while opening the fifth Dubai International Project Management Forum (DIPMF) Mattar Al Tayer, Director-General and Chairman of the Board of Executive Directors of RTA, said ,“The UAE has committed teams and huge resources for constructing projects related to the hosting of this huge international event. The budget set for roads and transportation projects in the lead up to the Expo is Dh15 billion.”

Superstars Hussein Al Jasmi and Mariah Carey throw a free concert to promote the upcoming Expo

The global phenomenon, Mariah Carey along with Emirati superstar Hussein Al Jasmi, will perform a live concert free of charge to all attendees in an effort to promote the upcoming Expo. The concert will take place on the 20th of October, starting the one year count down to the Dubai Expo 2020.

The Expo 2020 Dubai national pavilion is taking shape

Images released ahead of the Expo 2020 showcased the masterpiece that is the UAE’s national pavilion. The design is truly spellbinding, and the pictures do speak for themselves. “The pavilion will be one of the Expo’s greatest icons. The design will evoke the pioneering spirit and power of connections that transformed the UAE from a collection of small, desert communities, into a global connection point,” said UAE Minister of State for International Cooperation and Director-General of Expo 2020 Dubai H.E. Reem Ebrahim Al Hashimy. “The UAE pavilion will become an important cornerstone in our site and will have a legacy plan that will reflect our hopes and ambitions for the many years to come.”

Dubai’s USD 680 million deep tunnel project to be ready for the Expo

In a groundbreaking infrastructure project, the newly-established deep tunnel will drain rainwater in the Airport City and Expo 2020 districts. When completed, the USD 680 million project will be one of the most specialized tunnels in the world.

At the time being, after 4 million working hours and drilling with the largest drillers in the region, the project is 65 percent done and is scheduled to be fully functional by September of 2020, a month before the Expo.

Emirati Performer Hussein Al Jasmi has been named an Expo 2020 Ambassador

In the lead up to the World’s Greatest Show, Dubai decided to name Emirati artist/sensation Hussein Al Jasmi as one of the Expo 2020 official ambassadors. As the world sets its eyes towards Dubai, the leading Emirate showcases the best of what it has to offer in all fields, including art.

What is Property Management? 

Property management is the overseeing of residential, commercial and/or industrial real estate, including apartments, villas, etc. It typically involves the managing of property that is owned by another party and the property manager acts on behalf of the owner to preserve the value of the property while generating income.

Why choose a Property Management Company?
When it comes to managing properties, handing the keys to the tenant does not mean that the work ends there. With a long list of things to consider before, during, and after leasing the property, will you have enough time for yourself? A lot of landlords tend to manage their investment properties themselves by collecting rent, taking care of the property, handling tenant complaints, arranging maintenance repairs etc., rather than hiring an experienced Property Management Company, as they find it to be an expense rather than an advantage. Landlords do not foresee that the management of a property could be a full time job rather than a casual oversee.
You should consider hiring a Property Management Company if the answer to any of the below is a “yes” or is relatable to you:

  1. If you own multiple rental units.
  2. If your rental units are geographically widespread.
  3. If you lack experience managing properties.
  4. If you don’t have the time to manage your properties.
  5. If you cannot be a stern Landlord or do not like confrontation.
  6. If you do not deal well with stress.
  7. If you are currently overwhelmed with your property(s).
  8. If you do not have experience to manage maintenance and repairs.
  9. If you require assistance with account and/or record keeping of your property.

title: The Largest and Amazing Shopping Malls in Dubai – UAE
author: Prestige Luxury Real Estate
html:
Indulge in the ultimate retail therapy with almost one-hundred magnificent malls; Dubai is a true Mecca for shoppers. Each mall has its own unique characteristics; The Dubai Mall is palatial, one of the largest in the world, while Ibn Battuta Mall oozes culture.  If you truly do shop till you drop, unwind with one of the many entertainment options or feast from a melting pot of international flavours.

Watch the related video

Mall of the Emirates
Mall of the Emirates is a shopping mall in Dubai. Developed and owned by Majid Al Futtaim Properties, it opened in November 2005 and is located at interchange four on Sheikh Zayed road.
The multi-level shopping mall currently features more than 630 retail outlets, 7900 parking spaces, over 100 restaurants & Cafes, 80 luxury stores and 250 flagship stores. It has a total gross leasable area of 255,489 square meters. It also hosts family leisure activities including Ski Dubai (the Middle East’s first indoor ski resort and snow park), the 500-seat capacity Dubai Community Theatre and Arts Centre and Magic planet, one of the largest indoor family entertainment centres in Dubai. Home to 600+ brands, no trip is complete without a visit to the Mall of the Emirates. Dine under the European inspired Fashion Dome or shop luxury brands. If you want to unwind, head down to Yalla! Bowling or chill in the snow at Dubai’s first indoor ski resort- Ski Dubai.


Dubai Marina Mall
In terms of scale, 140 outlets and a gross leasable area spanning 390,000 sq. ft. are tiered over four levels that bring together high-street fashion brands, aspirational couture, al fresco dining before a shimmering waterfront, cinematic thrills at Reel Cinemas, engaging children’s entertainment, and even the convenience of a supermarket.
If you’re looking for affordable high-street fashion or for an afternoon of self-care, head down to the Dubai Marina Mall. Spice things up with a new haircut at one of its many salons and enjoy some lunch along the water’s edge for a truly relaxing weekend experience. Large waterfront shopping & dining complex with big-name stores, a supermarket & food outlets.

Watch the related video

The Dubai Mall
The Dubai Mall is a shopping mall in Dubai. It is the second-largest mall in the world by total land area, and the 26th-largest shopping mall in the world by gross leasable area, tying with West Edmonton Mall and Fashion Island (Thailand) — both of which are older than it. It has a Gross leasable area (GLA) of 350,000 m2 (3,800,000 sq ft). Located next to the world’s tallest building (the Burj Khalifa); this larger-than-life mall will take care of all your shopping needs. The Dubai Mall covers a total area of more than 1 million square meters and accommodates over 1,200 shops, 120 restaurants and cafes, an ice rink, a SEGA game centre, a five-star hotel and a 22 screen cinema. It also boasts the world’s largest indoor aquarium - 'Dubai Aquarium and Underwater Zoo'.

Dubai Outlet Mall
Dubai Outlet Mall (DOM) is a shopping mall in Dubailand, Dubai, the UAE. Developed and owned by Al Ahli Holding Group, it opened in August 2007 and is located on the Dubai-Al Ain Road near the Dubai Bypass Road interchange.
The Dubai Outlet Mall is the ultimate destination for bargain hunters. Its 240 stores carry more than a thousand premium brands, with discounts ranging between 30-90%. Keep your kids occupied with games at Chuck E Cheese and fun rides in other play areas. The mall houses over 1,200 brands that include Alexander McQueen, Dolce & Gabbana, Façonnable, Kenzo, Iceberg, Coach, Burberry, Missoni, Roberto Cavalli and more.


Ibn Battuta Mall
Immerse yourself in the cultures of the world at Ibn Battuta Mall; named after the famous Moroccan explorer, the mall’s six courts are each inspired by Andalusia, Tunisia, Egypt, Persia, India and China, the regions in which he travelled. Ibn Battuta Mall should be your stop for everything fashion, lifestyle and sporting goods.
The Ibn Battuta Mall is a large shopping mall on the Sheikh Zayed Road in Dubai close to Interchange 6 for Jebel Ali Village. Having more than 270 shops, 50 restaurants, a 21-screen cinema and over 4,500 parking spaces on a total of 521,000 m², Ibn Battuta is the world's largest themed shopping mall.


BurJuman
BurJuman is one of the oldest shopping malls in Dubai, in the residential area of Bur Dubai, in Dubai, UAE. It is developed and owned by Al Ghurair Group. The distinctive landmark comprises over 2.8 million square feet of mixed-use space including the shopping mall, business tower, hotel suites and duplex residences. The mall comprises over 800,000 sq ft (74,000 m2).
In November 2003, BurJuman won 2 MAXI Merit awards from The International Council of Shopping Centers. In March 2006, BurJuman was awarded the "Mall of the Year" award at the prestigious 1st Retail Middle East Awards.


City Centre Deira
"Enjoy Shopping, Magic Planet & Cinemas"
City Centre Deira - Dubai, UAE, first opened its doors in November 1995. At the time, it virtually redefined the concept of "malls" for the region. As the first large-scale, mixed-use shopping destination, complete with retail outlets, restaurants, entertainment facilities and a hotel, City Centre Deira created an international dimension for one-stop shopping and entertainment for the Middle East, bringing it to an entirely new level.
City Centre Deira encompasses over 123,028 square meters of retail space and features over 371 retail stores and services. Its entertainment facilities include Magic Planet, one of the region's most popular indoor family entertainment centres; VOX Cinemas, a 20-screen cinema multiplex with 3,000 seats. The Centre also provides direct access to the 5-star City Centre Hotel & Residence, managed by Pullman. The Centre also features the MAF Tower, an 11-storey office building.
City Centre Deira is one of the flagship malls within the Majid Al Futtaim Properties portfolio and ranks as one of the most successful shopping malls in the world. With average annual footfall traffic in excess of 22 million, City Centre Deira remains one of the region's most visited destinations for both residents and tourists alike.

title: Best Beautiful Public Beaches in Dubai - UAE
author: Prestige Luxury Real Estate
html:
Whether you’re looking for a short break in the sun or a family beach holiday, Dubai’s beaches hold the key. Jump in and out of the crystal clear waters on Kite Beach, snap a selfie in front of Burj Al Arab or enjoy being pampered at one of Dubai’s new beach districts. Sun, sand, blue skies and even bluer water – find the perfect beach for you – and enjoy Dubai as the perfect destination for holidays in the sun.


La Mer: Don’t think of how much you’re going to spend, because we got you one of the perfect free beaches in Dubai. If you want to relax, eat, play and have fun, we promise you the perfect day at the sea.
Dubai’ s newest beachside destination has a lot to offer. From exceptional restaurants and cafes, standout boutiques to shop at and an outdoor trampoline park for little ones, it’ s easy to spend the entire day here. Choose from the North Beach or South Beach, which each have colourful shower cabins adding to the seafresh theme of the precinct. There are plenty of watersports to try too, including wakeboarding, flyboarding and kayaking.
Activities: Hire colorful cabanas, Trampoline playground for kids, Laguna Waterpark with 5 waterslides, Lazy River ride, Water hammock.
(Sur La Mer Properties)


Sunset Beach: For the quintessential “holding up the Burj Al Arab” photograph, this spot will get you the best side of Dubai’s iconic hotel. The free beach is a perpetual hive of activity and one of the emirate's most beautiful stretches of sand. Also known as Umm Suqeim Beach, head to nearby Surf House Dubai to rent a board and discuss surf conditions over a coffee.


The Beach by JBR: The Beach, opposite The Walk promenade at Jumeirah Beach Residences, boasts its juice bars, burger joints and fashionable boutiques and the fanciest cars in town. Pick up an inflatable pool lounge before heading to the water or simply float out and take on the Dubai Aqua Park, an inflatable waterpark. This beach is one of our favourites for families too - with watersports, banana boating, camel rides and more. Perfect for a beach holiday.
(JBR PROPERTIES)

Kite Beach: Are you looking for the best beach to visit in Dubai? Blemishless colors, sea smell, white sand, and gorgeous views, can all be found in one of the best beaches in Dubai, Kite Beach. It is considered Dubai’s favorite beach because of its space, qualities and the number of activities one can do there.
If the name didn't already give it away, Dubai's sportiest beach is a favourite with kite surfers. Get here for a spot of beach volleyball or try your balance at stand-up paddle-boarding and kayaking. There are plenty of non-aqua activities, including a skatepark, an outdoor trampoline and a toddler-friendly area. This is a top spot for a family beach holiday. Post-swim, make your way to one of the many beach canteens. We recommend the famous Salt, a food cart style café serving up some of the best beef sliders in the city.


Al Mamzar Beach Park: You came here to find the best public beaches in Dubai, so we will make it easy for you. Al Mamzar Beach Park is an amazing choice if you’re looking for top beaches in Dubai. It is located between Dubai and Sharjah, so if you want to spend the day with no hassle, it is better to wake up as early as you can to avoid traffic and enjoy the beach in the morning. There is also this amazing peculiarity of being one of the ladies only beaches in Dubai on Mondays and Wednesdays.


Black Palace Beach: Known as Black Palace Beach thanks to its locations next to one of Dubai’ s royal residences, this drive-up spot may be hard to find, but it offers the calmest waters and most stunning sunsets in the city. Follow the pathway to discover an untouched shoreline, featuring views of Palm Jumeirah and Burj Al Arab in the distance. While there are no facilities at this beach, it’ s a great place to escape the bustle of the city.

title: Top 8 Attractions to Visit in Dubai During Summer
author: Prestige Luxury Real Estate
html:
Dubai is no doubt one of the United Arab Emirates’ top holiday spot. This urban city of skyscrapers and shopping malls has successfully transformed from a desert outpost to a popular destination, where tourists flock for sales bargains, sunshine, and loads of family fun and Dubai is one of the hottest countries in summer, it is an amazing go-to destination for summer activities. Here, we will be listing the best places to visit in Dubai during summer so you can fight the summer heat in style.
Dubai is famous for sightseeing attractions such as the Burj Khalifa (the world’s tallest building) and shopping malls that come complete with mammoth aquariums and indoor ski slopes. There are lots of amazing attractions but we are here to narrow it Top 8 attractions to visit in Dubai during summer.


Aquaventure Waterpark: “Vast water park with zip lines, slides through shark-filled lagoons & a splash area for kids.” If you’re wondering what to do in Dubai in summer, we suggest Aquaventure Waterpark for sure. This place is excellent for families as it has over 30 water slides and a lot of water activities to enjoy. It also includes Dubai’s largest Aquarium with more than 65,000 aquatic animals, as well as some friendly dolphins at Dolphin Bay.
Location: Adventure Waterpark, Atlantis Hotel, Crescent Road, The Palm Jumeirah.
Activities: Ride Lazy River and Water Slides / Interact with dolphins and sea lions / Dive at Shark Lagoon / Kids play at Splashers Island.


IMG World of Adventures: World’s Largest Indoor Theme Park: The IMG World of Adventures is a place that one must visit when travelling to Dubai, especially since the indoor amusement park is not only the perfect destination for families and friends to enjoy but also a spot for amazing photos and memories to be taken and build.
“IMG Worlds of Adventure is an indoor amusement park in the United Arab Emirates in Dubai. It is Dubai’s first mega themed entertainment destination. The park is divided into five "epic zones".
The park features many thrilling adrenaline-pumping rides that are based on the iconic MARVEL Super Heroes, which includes The Hulk, Thor, Iron Man, Spider-Man and the Avengers. The Velociraptor ride was one joy of a ride. Even a person like me who is afraid of heights found it fun. It was both a shocking and thrilling experience as it’s the only semi-indoor ride that takes you out for an adventure. You’ll be able to enjoy the scenic view outside with numerous twist and turns for that few minutes. It is a ride that is definitely worth queuing for!
What’s more? This huge theme park even takes you back to your childhood days where Cartoon Network was what we will all be excited about when we turn on our television. Get ready to have your mindset change from all those cartoon characters that we once thought were simply cute. The one word to best describe those themed rides is “WOW!” The Powerpuff Girls ride takes you spinning around in the air, which totally changes that “soft-hearted perception” we had of those crime-fighting girls.


Ski Dubai is an indoor ski resort with 22,500 square meters of indoor ski area. The park maintains the temperature of -1 degree Celsius to 2 degrees Celsius throughout the year. It is a part of the Mall of the Emirates, one of the largest shopping malls in the world, located in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
This Snow Park is suitable for the entire family to enjoy as there are many fun-filled activities such as the Twin Track Bobsled runs, Snow Cavern filled with interactive experience, Tobogganing Hills, Giant Ball, chairlift ride, snow penguins, snow bullet, snowboarding and the most interesting activity of all, skiing.


Wild Wadi Water Park: This park is one of the best places to visit in Dubai in Summer, and it does not matter how old you are. You get to enjoy the rides and the superb view of Burj Al Arab. Another reason why this is one of the finest Dubai attractions in Summer is because they offer ladies night, that only women and little children can enjoy. The park is based on Juha, a famous character from the Arabian folklore; there is Juha’s Journey (a river that guests to float in and relax) and Juha’s Dhow and Lagoon (a play area for children with more than 100 games and water rides)
Location: Jumeirah Street, Next to Burj Al Arab, Jumeirah 2, Dubai.
Activities: Enjoy water slides and pumping rides / Go on relaxing experience in Juha’s Journey / Children can enjoy water guns in Dhow and Lagoon.

Dubai Creek: “The Creek is where Dubai legacy truly lives,” a quote said by one of the Creek’s admirers. Dubai Creek connects the sea to the dessert which gives it an amazing view and makes it one of the biggest tourist places in Dubai in Summer. Its weather is one of the main attractions; it’s breezy and nice that would make you comfortable and content in your visit.
“Dubai Creek is a saltwater creek located in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Previously it extended to Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary but as part of the new Dubai canal it extends through to the Persian Gulf.”
Location: Mashraf Building, Dubai
Activities: Take a water taxi or wooden dhow cruise / Play with dolphins at Dubai Dolphinarium / Take an interesting walk down the Lane / Enjoy street shows.

Dubai Ice Rink: Still not satisfied and looking for more adrenaline rush? Dubai Ice Rink should do the trick. The Olympic-size Ice Rink has become one of the must-visit entertainment destinations in Dubai to both kids and adults alike. People can enjoy skating sessions or just have fun skating with their freestyle. Also, there are D.J nights when skaters can dance too. It surely counts as one of the most fun things to do in Dubai during Summer.
Location: Finance Center Road, Dubai Mall, Dubai
Activities: Disco ice skating / Family DJ party / Skate under the snowfall / Ice Hockey lessons.


Dive Atlantis: In case you’re a sea lover or a diving guru, this will be one of the nicest places to visit in Dubai in June. It gets rather hot especially in this month, so you need to chill in a cool place. It is part of the luxurious hotel Atlantis The Palm, and it offers diving courses for all divers as per difficulty level. It is the spot for over 65,000 marine animals, which gives you a fabulous chance to interact with them.
Location: Crescent Road, Palm Island, Dubai
Activities: Snorkel in the Ambassador Lagoon with thousands of animals swimming around / Walk under water in the Ambassador Lagoon / Scuba Diving
There are a huge number of high-quality beaches that you can visit and enjoy the sea and sand experience in Dubai. Click this link to find out more about the Best Beaches in Dubai.
“Shall I compare thee to a Summer’s day,” said William Shakespeare, who unfortunately did not get to spend a “Summer’s day” in Dubai. Since you got to know the best places to go in Dubai in Summer, it is time to start that holiday to cool off and have a blast.


The Outlet Village Dubai: The Outlet Village is an upscale indoor retail destination, which offers a unique value shopping experience for the most iconic international fashion brands in a distinctive and stunning environment. It is located on Jebel Ali Road, adjacent to Dubai Parks and Resorts (just off on Sheikh Zayed Road).
The Outlet Village, spanning over actual 25,000 square feet with a projection to expand shortly to 3 million square feet by 2018, is convenient located between both Dubai and Abu Dhabi, making it the ideal shopping destination for modern day fashionistas to pick up their favourite clothing.
The Outlet Village’s iconic architectural design takes inspiration from the picturesque medieval Italian hill town of San Gimignano and UNESCO World Heritage site located in Tuscany. Its authentic and bespoke craftsmanship gives it an overall classic European heritage feeling.
This village mall currently houses over 125 luxury retail brands, including three department stores, international dining and a plethora of brands such as DKNY, Dunhill, Armani, Coach and much more. The upcoming expansion will increase the total number of luxury international brands to 450.
Take an amazing shot at this spot at the end of the mall! It’s definitely worth it to head down there as there are many offers, deals and cash back rebates awaiting for you there.

author: Prestige Luxury Real Estate
html:
Dubai is an urban wonderland with many of its communities like self-contained mini-cities within the bigger metropolis. Each have their own individual vibe and places to hang out - we explore the top 4.

Downtown Dubai:
Those looking at moving to Downtown Dubai should be aware of the benefits of the area and some of the things to consider before setting up home here.
Downtown Dubai is the city’s busy tourism hub, home to the towering Burj Khalifa skyscraper, with its observation deck, and the dancing Dubai Fountain, where crowds gather to watch music and light shows. The sprawling Dubai Mall offers global fashion brands and casual eateries, while Emaar Boulevard has a chic cafe scene. The Dubai Opera hosts dance, opera and musicals in a striking dhow-shaped building.
“Home to the landmark that is the Burj Khalifa, you can expect the best from Downtown and you still won’t be disappointed. Fill your day with shopping in The Dubai Mall, stop off at the Aquarium with the kids and then swing by the Dubai Opera for a show and dinner at the up-and-coming Kizmet, and make sure you don’t miss the Fountain show.”
(Downtown Properties)


City Walk:
What’s Dubai City Walk? City Walk is a mixed-use development to the northwest of Downtown Dubai. It boasts a good selection of shops, many places to eat and drink, a cinema, attractions, and residential apartments. Cafes and restaurants in an outdoor retail complex with a tree-lined esplanade and central fountain.
Dubai is never short of swanky establishments, least of all in City Walk. This area is definitely one for individuals who like to have options. If decision making is not your strong suit, you may be in trouble! Cocoa Kitchen is for the chocoholics, with chocolate infused food, or if you have less of a sweet tooth, Eggspectation won’t disappoint. Check out Roxy Cinemas, explore Green Planet or grab dinner in the newly opened La Ville Hotel & Suites. Want to see it in the flesh?


Dubai Marina:
Dubai Marina is an affluent residential neighborhood known for The Beach at JBR, a leisure complex with al fresco dining and sandy stretches to relax on. Smart cafes and pop-up craft markets line waterside promenade Dubai Marina Walk, while Dubai Marina Mall is packed with chain and luxury fashion brands. Upscale yachts cruise through the large man-made marina, where activities range from jet-skiing to skydiving.
By day and night, the Marina offers numerous activities and fantastic eateries. One of our favorite features is the Marina Zip Line. Reaching speeds of 80 kms per hour, you’ll screech your way from JBR and finish at Dubai Marina Mall. The modest mall also deserves a shoutout, with its excellent shopping, cinema experience and connection to the well-known Pier 7, home to Mama Zonia, the winner of Time Out 2019 casual dining newcomer award.
(Dubai Marina Apartments)  


Jumeirah Lakes Towers – JLT
The Jumeirah Lakes Towers is a large development in Dubai, United Arab Emirates which consists of 80 towers being constructed along the edges of three artificial lakes as well as the JLT Embankment of 8 tower facing Jumeirah Islands.
Dubai waited and watched, mainly from a traffic jam, while JLT was constructed. Now, it’s a staple among Dubai’s communities. JLT wears its diversity right on its sleeve, attracting families, couples and singles of all different cultures, who enjoy the treasure trove of restaurants. Fat Aunts takes you on a tour of Eastern street food, the local Mcgettigans offers fry ups and Sunday Roasts, and across the lake, Mythos serves up traditional Greek food.

title: 3D Printed House Success is pushing new frontiers in Architecture in SHARJAH
author: Prestige Luxury Real Estate
html:
In 2016, Dubai launched the most ambitious project “Office of the Future” the most advanced 3D printed building which created a new wave in architecture designing.  Now, Sharjah has taken the challenge to build the entire house 3D printed with state-of-the art technology. Sharjah is aiming to establish as a preferred destination for future architecture like its counterpart Dubai.
How to 3D-print an office
A 3D-printer measuring 6 metres in height, 36 metres in length and 12 metres in width was used. It took only 17 days to print and was installed on site in two days, significantly faster compared to traditional construction methods. The process required one person to monitor the printer’s functioning, seven people to install the building components, as well as a team of ten electricians and specialists to take care of the mechanical and electrical engineering. The entire cost of the project was only 140,000 dollars: the technique cut both building and labour costs by 50 per cent compared to conventional buildings of similar size, according to Reuters. These savings translate into enhanced productivity, higher economic returns and increased sustainability if invested conscientiously.

Sharjah's first 3D printed house could be ready by the third quarter of this year at the Sharjah Research, Technology and Innovation Park (SRTI Park). SRTI Park has announced that it has attracted the attention of several international companies that specialise in the construction of buildings with 3D Printing techniques. The project is as a result of triple helix collaboration of government, private, and academia, where CyBe Construction, a Dutch organisation, has been selected as the technology provider to build the 3D house in SRTI Park. The American University of Sharjah (AUS) will support in research and talent. group of students from the Faculty of Engineering at AUS will get hands-on training on this technique.

title: UAE Real Estate Market Getting Back on Track
author: Prestige Luxury Real Estate
html:
International investors have shown significant interest in the UAE's real estate market following the introduction of long-term visas, which was strongly reflected in the value of transactions recorded in the first five months of this year.
The total value of Dubai real estate transactions jumped 33 per cent to Dh34 billion in the January-May period compared to Dh24 billion for the same period last year, Dubai Land Department figures revealed, reflecting a strong interest in the sector.
The value of residential and commercial properties reached Dh17 billion, while land-purchasing transactions totalled Dh14 billion and villa deals stood at Dh3 billion during the first five months of 2019.
Property developers revealed that the news of long-term visas has been well-received internationally as enquiries from foreign buyers, especially from China, grew from prospective buyers. The consistent decline in prices over the years have made the UAE's property market pretty attractive and affordable.


Grande at Opera District


"We have seen a significant increase in demand from international investors for our residential launches this year, which reflects the positive outlook of the government and the strength of Dubai's economy. We see interest from across the world, particularly from South Asian and Southeast Asian nations, Europe, the wider Middle East and Africa. China and Russia have been particularly high-growth markets, also highlighted by the growth in the number of tourists from these countries," said Ahmad Al Matrooshi, managing director of Emaar Properties.
He said the issuance of long-term visas for investors in property, as well as other forward-looking policies that help attract professionals and entrepreneurs, underline the long-term vision of the leadership to establish Dubai and the UAE as a global hub for business and leisure.
The UAE is giving long-term visas - five and 10 years - to investors, entrepreneurs and professionals; specialists in the medical, scientific, research and technical fields; and students and outstanding pupils to facilitate business and create an attractive and encouraging investment environment in the country.
A minimum investment of Dh5 million is needed to obtain a five-year visa, and double that amount is necessary for a decade-long visa. The Federal Authority for Identity and Citizenship in the UAE said last month that around 6,000 investors and entrepreneurs had applied for long-term visas in the first week.
Some of the wealthy expat businessmen have already been awarded 10-year visas, as well as permanent residency "Gold Card". They have invested millions of dirhams in the UAE's economy over the decades. The first batch of 6,800 investors with Dh100 billion worth of investments has started receiving the Gold Card from UAE authorities.

Golfvita Damac Properties


Niall McLoughlin, senior vice-president at Damac Properties, said: "since the news of the long-term visas was announced, there has been an increase in enquiries from the prospective investors from China and other countries".
"Since the news came out last year, we have seen an increase in the number of enquiries coming from our offices in China and at our international roadshows, which shows that this has been positively received by the international market. Additionally, we also anticipate that the new visa laws will further encourage existing UAE residents to consider buying property here, as they recognize the added benefits of owning their own property in the UAE, be it as an investment or a home," he added.
Lynnette Abad, director of research and data at Property Finder, has said that permanent residency is a game-changer for the real estate industry in Dubai.
"We are yet to get full details of the Gold Card programme, such as who can qualify, the terms, etc. However, it's definitely a step in the right direction and very much needed to stimulate investment, especially foreign direct investment," Abad said.

Emaar Downtown


Al Matrooshi said in addition to strong demand for assets near Emaar's tourist site in Downtown, there has been strong interest from international buyers to invest in villas, townhouses and apartments.
"The launch of Golf Expo villas in Emaar South recorded sell-out response for all four of its phases, similar to the demand for the townhouses launched in Arabian Ranches III. There have also been consistent growth in demand for waterfront residences in Dubai Creek Harbour, the exquisite beachfront homes in Emaar Beachfront, apartments in Downtown Dubai as well as for Sirdhana homes. The positive initiatives by the government will continue to impact positively on the real estate sector."
